meta.title: National Growth Fund v11 standalone beta/regime data
meta.purpose: Standalone market dependency profiles generated from data/v11-universe.json.
meta.methodology: Two-factor model: stock return = alpha + betaMarket*KOSPI + betaSemiExcess*(SEMI proxy - KOSPI) + residual.
